label: Claude Sonnet 5.5
output:
**To my neighbors at Larkspur Lofts,**

I'm Jess Okafor in 5A, and I've lived here for three years. I'm writing about the drone some of you saw or heard on Saturday, October 31, and about the note that was posted in the lobby.

I flew a small camera drone from the roof deck for about 11 minutes around 4:00 p.m. I'm a wedding photographer, and I had just bought a new drone. I was testing it before a vineyard wedding in Dundee. The camera was pointed west toward the river and the Fremont Bridge the entire time. It was never aimed at any windows or units, and I wasn't recording anyone's home or private space.

I understand why it looked and sounded unsettling. A drone hovering over the courtyard is strange if you don't know what's going on, and I'm sorry it worried people. I've heard it was especially upsetting for some of the children who saw it. That was not my intention, and I should have thought about how it would come across to the people who live here.

Because I'd like anyone who's concerned to be able to see for themselves, I'm happy to show the full, unedited footage from that flight. You can knock on 5A or email me at jess.okafor@mailbox.example, and I'll go through it with you.

I want to be honest about one more thing. The note in the lobby called me a creep and included my unit number. I didn't think that was fair, and it was hard to have my name and door put in front of the whole building that way. I'm not interested in a fight, but I'd ask that if something worries any of us in the future, we come talk to each other directly instead of posting notes.

The HOA rules don't address drones, so I'm going to ask the board to put the topic on the agenda for the November 19 meeting, at 7:00 p.m. in the community room. Until the board decides on a rule, I won't fly from the roof deck. Everyone is welcome to attend and weigh in.

Thank you for reading, and thank you for your patience.

Sincerely,
Jess Okafor
Unit 5A
